title: The Hardware Detective
hook: Why does a Kafka broker need RAM?
challenge: Explain how processes, memory and disk constrain a pipeline; compare local requirements.

title: Race Against the Index
hook: Why is a query slow on 100,000 rows?
challenge: Compare EXPLAIN plans before and after indexing and quantify write overhead.

title: The Timezone Puzzle
hook: An event belongs to different calendar days in different zones.
challenge: Normalize timestamps to UTC and test a daylight-saving transition.

title: The Mysterious Duplicate
hook: The same business event arrives three times.
challenge: Break idempotency, write a failing regression test and implement a safe correction.

title: The Anonymous Visitor
hook: Does a public API key grant unlimited database access?
challenge: Design a negative RLS test in an isolated environment.

title: Time Travel in the Warehouse
hook: Which region did an event belong to last week?
challenge: Model SCD2 history and implement an as-of event join.

title: The Impossible DAG
hook: Task A depends on B, and B depends on A.
challenge: Detect a dependency cycle in a graph before scheduling any tasks.

title: Misleading Statistics
hook: A data-quality rule flags 20% of events.
challenge: Measure false positives and defend a better quality threshold.

title: One Metric, Two Answers
hook: Two dashboards show different values for the same KPI.
challenge: Define a metric contract and verify the fact grain.

title: The Release That Broke Everything
hook: A migration passed locally but failed after delivery.
challenge: Design a backward-compatible migration and rollback decision.

title: The Slow Giant
hook: Why might Spark be slower than DuckDB for a tiny dataset?
challenge: Compare process startup, data I/O and computation time fairly.

title: A Message From the Past
hook: An old event arrives after a newer source correction.
challenge: Model out-of-order events and a bounded watermark.

title: Five Minutes to an SLO
hook: The pipeline succeeded but the consumer's data is stale.
challenge: Calculate a freshness error budget and propose an alert.

title: The System Design Interview
hook: Tomorrow the source sends 100 times more events.
challenge: Compare three designs on latency, cost and operational complexity.
